title: Final Answer for N
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for N including the numerical constant.

title: Final Answer for C_v
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that C_v is proportional to T^3.

title: Density of States
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive or reference the density of states for the photon gas correctly.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the integrals for N and energy density correctly.

title: Use of Beta
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly define and use beta in their calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect limits of integration or sign mistakes.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Qualitative Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a qualitative explanation for the heat capacity result.
